card.name: Digits inside dose and calorie numbers
card.fires_on: Digits partway through a number (the 1 of 1200 mg, the 0 of 600 calories) in dosing or meal instructions, and a few words like 'least' or 'used' just before an amount.

modes.label: Digits in numbers
modes.description: A digit inside a dose, calorie count or time amount, before the unit appears.

modes.label: Words before amounts
modes.description: A short word such as 'least' that leads into a quantity.
modes.example: containing at<< least>> 100 mL of diluent

modes.label: Bracket before converted temperature
modes.description: An opening bracket before a Fahrenheit value after Celsius.
